	📋 How to Apply IIT BHU Non-Teaching Post Recruitment 2026 for 55 Post

	
		Visit the official SAMARTH portal iitbhunt.samarth.edu.in or IIT BHU website iitbhu.ac.in.
		Click on Sign Up / Register and create an account with valid Email ID and Mobile Number.
		Log in and select Advertisement No. 03/2026-27 (Non-Teaching Posts – 55 Vacancies).
		Fill personal, educational, experience and category details carefully and upload required documents.
		Pay the application fee online (Group B: ₹500, Group C: ₹250; Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/Female) via Net Banking / Card / UPI.
		Submit the form on or before 24 September 2026 (5:00 PM) and take a printout.
		Send the printed application + self-attested documents by Speed Post to The Registrar, IIT (BHU), Varanasi – 221005 within 7 days.
	

	Note: Check official notification before applying. No correction is allowed after final submit. Keep Application Number safely.
